title: 2020-03-13 Meeting notes - Enable SSO for inter-ikea GitHub organization
content:
Location: Microsoft Teams Meeting

Link to Outlook Item: click here

Invitation Message

Participants

Gaurang Pandya (Meeting Organizer)

Jathisan Chandrasegaram (Accepted in Outlook)

Joakim Hogart (Accepted in Outlook)

Jimmy Dahlqvist (Accepted in Outlook)


Notes

We are ready to enable SSO for existing GitHub Organization "inter-ikea".


@Joakim We have investigated creating an IPEX organization to be able to proceed without affecting existing setup.

@Jathisan There are several initiatives ongoing regarding how we will use GitHub from IIG perspective. Let's get integration for inter-ikea and inter.ikea.com AD in place as short term solution. Not involved first hand in any initiative.


@Joakim We have vendors that do not have IKEA accounts. Currently it is possible to invite guests to Azure AD for Inter IKEA. What is planned for the future? Is it OK to use this for pilot with DEXF?

@Gaurang Work is ongoing on how to handle guests and to enable bring your own identity that will most likely affect how this is handled in the future. It is OK invite guests for pilot.


Action points:

@Gaurang will send naming convention for security groups

@Joakim will supply needed security groups

@Gaurang Will make @Joakim and @Jimmy owner of group(s) to manage users

@Gaurang Will set up meeting with @Jathisan to set up GitHub to Azure AD integration
